title: EvidenceManifestConsumerSubset
description: Development-only CP-1 typed evidence denominator. The criterion denominator is what this increment owes: the criteria frozen by the authored gate policies plus every acceptance criterion the canonical specification declares, and each one carries exactly one typed disposition. The generated traceability index is a coverage map, not a source of obligations, and is not read. The deferred denominator is the deferred suites of the expected-suite registry; capability components are not a denominator source, so an exercised capability is never forced to declare itself unexercised. Gate-policy criterion keys, acceptance-criterion codes and suite ids each keep their own namespace.
$comment: docs/internal/DECISIONS.md D37 (gh#175): this v1 shape absorbed several unversioned incompatible edits during PR #171's review (artifacts->criteria, deferred_sources->deferred_capabilities->deferred_suites, criterionDisposition's required set and key patterns) before any consumer existed. Its normative shape (required/properties/$defs) is now locked to schema.const by tests/contracts/evidence/test_evidence_manifest.py::TestSchemaVersioningDiscipline; a future incompatible change (gh#174 included) publishes a new evidence-manifest-v2.schema.json with $id/schema.const bumped to /v2, per the contracts/domain/migration/*-v2.schema.json precedent, and never edits this file's normative shape in place. title/description/$comment stay free to edit.

criteria.$comment: uniqueItems refuses an identical repeated row. JSON Schema 2020-12 cannot express uniqueness by key, so a repeated criterion carrying a different payload is refused by name at the criterion chokepoint in tests/contracts/evidence.

deferred_suites.$comment: minItems refuses an empty deferred roster while the expected-suite registry still defers a suite; uniqueItems refuses an identical repeated row. A repeated suite id carrying a different payload is refused by name at the deferred-suite chokepoint in tests/contracts/evidence.
